name: docx-to-pdf-markdownlint
description: The markdownlint gate's tool: `npm ci` installs exactly package-lock.json's tree. The overrides lift markdownlint-cli2's exact pins of markdown-it and smol-toml, and micromark-extension-math's `^0.16` katex (markdownlint parses math syntax only and never calls katex), to releases with their security fixes.
